description: Put tracked keywords under a tag, in bulk — or clear their tag — and/or say whether they are brand terms for Search Visibility. The tag is named, not looked up: a name that does not exist yet is created. A keyword carries at most one tag, so assigning replaces whatever it had. `brand` is separate from tags: `own` (your app's name) and `competitor` (a rival's name) leave the terms out of the visibility score, `none` counts them whatever detection says, `auto` hands them back to detection. Send `brand` without `tag` to change only that — the tags stay as they are. This is the tool for organising a large corpus after reading it with get_keywords, which is drudgery in the console and one call here.

app_id.description: Apptail app id for one of YOUR apps — from get_account. Tags belong to an app.

brand.description: Whether these terms are somebody's name, for Search Visibility (get_keywords `include: ["visibility"]`). `own` = your app's name, `competitor` = a rival's: both are listed and left out of the score, because you rank #1 for your own name whatever your ASO does. `none` = count them anyway. `auto` = let title-word detection decide again. Detection is shown on each row's `brand.reason`; override it when it is wrong (a transliterated rival name, a generic word it took for a name). Omit to leave the brand decision alone. Sent without `tag`, only the brand decision changes.

color.description: Hex colour for a tag being created, e.g. "#2563eb". Ignored when the tag already exists. Omit and one is picked from the palette that the app is not already using.

keyword_ids.description: Apptail keyword ids to tag, as returned by get_keywords. Ids, not terms. Up to 500 in one call. A keyword the app does not track is reported back rather than silently ignored.

tag.description: The tag name to put them under. Created if it does not exist. Omit — or send null — to clear the tag off these keywords instead.

name: tag_keywords

action.description: `assigned` when a tag was set, `cleared` when the tag was taken off, `untouched` when only `brand` was sent and the tags were left as they were.

app_id.description: The app whose corpus was changed.

brand.description: The brand decision applied (`own`, `competitor`, `none`, `auto`), or null when none was sent. Search Visibility recomputes on the next get_keywords read.

brand_changed_count.description: How many keywords took the brand decision. 0 when `brand` was not sent.

changed_count.description: How many keywords had their tag changed. 0 on a brand-only call.

requested_count.description: How many keyword ids were sent.

tag.description: The tag the keywords now carry. Null when the action was `cleared`.

color.description: The colour it is drawn in, as a hex string. Decoration; do not read meaning into it.

keywords.description: How many of the app's tracked keywords carry this tag. Null when it was not counted for this call — never read a null as zero.

tag_id.description: Apptail tag id. Pass it to tag_keywords to assign this tag.

tag_created.description: True when this call created the tag rather than reusing one. Worth mentioning: a typo makes a second tag rather than an error.

tags.description: Every tag this app now has, so a follow-up call does not have to guess at names.

color.description: The colour it is drawn in, as a hex string. Decoration; do not read meaning into it.

keywords.description: How many of the app's tracked keywords carry this tag. Null when it was not counted for this call — never read a null as zero.

tag_id.description: Apptail tag id. Pass it to tag_keywords to assign this tag.

unknown_ids.description: Ids this app does not track, so nothing was changed for them. Empty on a clean run. Never present these as tagged.
